ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.error.en: Couldn’t save your agent’s wake setting. Try again.

ui.teamBridge.invitations.consent.bridge.en: Accepting lets your agent read and post in this conversation from now on. It sees every message and decides whether to reply; an @-mention means it should reply. You can change how often it wakes, or mute it.
ui.teamBridge.invitations.consent.bridge.translation: स्वीकार करने पर आपका एजेंट अब से इस बातचीत को पढ़ सकेगा और इसमें संदेश पोस्ट कर सकेगा। वह हर संदेश देखता है और खुद तय करता है कि जवाब देना है या नहीं; @ से उल्लेख का मतलब है कि उसे जवाब देना चाहिए। आप बदल सकते हैं कि उसे कितनी बार जगाया जाए, या उसे म्यूट कर सकते हैं।

ui.teamBridge.invitations.accepted.en: Accepted. {agent} now sees every message here and replies when it’s relevant or @-mentioned. Change this from the conversation’s ⋯ menu.
ui.teamBridge.invitations.accepted.translation: स्वीकार किया गया। {agent} अब यहाँ हर संदेश देखता है और प्रासंगिक होने पर या @ से उल्लेख होने पर जवाब देता है। इस सेटिंग को बातचीत के ⋯ मेन्यू से बदलें।
ui.teamBridge.invitations.accepted.main_translation: Accepted. {agent} is woken only when someone @-mentions it.

checks.meaning: The label is an imperative heading ('अपने एजेंट को इन पर जगाएँ') whose 'इन पर' supplies the postposition the bare noun rows need. accepted keeps round 3's fix 'इस सेटिंग को … बदलें' ('change this setting'), so the pointer names the setting rather than the agent. consent v2 keeps all four facts; its '@ से उल्लेख का मतलब है कि उसे जवाब देना चाहिए' matches the English 'an @-mention means it should reply'.
checks.terminology: mute = म्यूट (notify.mute, reused in agentNotify.mute and consent v2); setting = सेटिंग, as agentNotify.error and the round-3 fix use it; wake = जगाना / जगाया जाए (verb forms, which the hi guide prescribes inside sentences); agent = एजेंट; chief of staff = चीफ़ ऑफ़ स्टाफ़ (chief.fallback, thread.intro_chief).
checks.register_typography: आप register throughout; polite imperative ('जगाएँ', 'कोशिश करें'); danda । for full stops; no '!'.
checks.observations: HI-I1 is closed on disk (the round-3 fix is present). HI-I2 is a bookkeeping observation, not a copy defect: the glossary's wake row (§2 footnote 1) asks the wave that first translates wake strings to record its final call or exception in the locale guide; this label renders the heading with the verb जगाएँ rather than the table's noun जागृति, and the hi guide records no such exception.

findings.detail: Round 3's fix is present on disk: 'इस सेटिंग को बातचीत के ⋯ मेन्यू से बदलें।' names the setting, so 'change it' can no longer be read as changing the agent. Verified this round; it would have been MINOR had it shipped as 'इसे'.

Bookkeeping, not a copy defect: the glossary's wake row (§2 footnote 1) asks the wave that first translates wake strings to record its final call or exception in the locale guide. This label uses the imperative जगाएँ rather than the table's noun जागृति, and the hi guide (sha cited in references) records no such exception. The rendering is the natural Hindi heading for a verb-phrase label; the copy is accepted.
